notes: Surfaced 2026-05-14 — the cartographers-apprentice LLM hand-positioned every passage on a 300px-column grid; significant LLM token cost per story

title: Computed variable updates
summary: Extend the variable surface so a tool can emit relative/computed assignments (e.g. SugarCube <<set $cash to $cash + 100>>) instead of only literals; via an adjust_variable(name; delta) and/or a set_variable expression mode.
acceptance: LLM can express working +100 cash; +2 time periods; charm +/- 1 without hand-writing macros; emitted assignment is an unquoted expression that plays; extract-on-load tolerates expression setters
notes: Surfaced 2026-06-29 during a SugarCube life-sim feasibility probe — set_variable only accepts a literal; passing "$cash + 100" emits <<set $cash to \"$cash + 100\">> (quoted string; broken). The whole stat economy of a life-sim (every activity mutates stats relatively) is unbuildable without this. Smallest fix; highest impact of the three E07 gaps found this session. Per-format syntax (it/+=/++ etc.) in specs/011-variables/research.md

title: Conditional rendering + gated choices
summary: Tools to author format-correct conditional blocks and state-gated links/options — SugarCube <<if>>/<<else>>; [[links]] and choices visible only when a variable test passes; format equivalents for Harlowe/Chapbook/Snowman.
acceptance: LLM can gate a choice on a variable test (e.g. show the pass-exam option only when $intelligence gt 1 and $attendedSchool) and author day+location event triggers without hand-writing macros; round-trips through all four formats
notes: Surfaced 2026-06-29 life-sim probe — exam gating; the >=5 day-2/day-4 location events; and time->day rollover all need <<if>> + conditional link visibility that no current tool emits. E07 epic names conditional rendering but no feature row existed. Single largest blocker for stateful/guided-open-world stories. Per-format syntax — note Harlowe hook-attachment (if: c)[[[link]]]; word operators; Chapbook [if] modifiers no else-if; Snowman raw JS braces — in specs/011-variables/research.md

title: Widget + popup authoring
summary: Tools to author SugarCube widgets / Dialog popups (and format equivalents) — e.g. a reusable setstat widget that both mutates a stat and shows a notification popup whenever it changes.
acceptance: LLM can declare a reusable widget (passage tagged widget) and route stat mutations through it to show a popup; round-trips and plays
notes: Surfaced 2026-06-29 life-sim probe — design asks for a popup whenever a stat changes; no tool emits <<widget>> or <<dialog>>. Lower priority than F-VAR-MATH/F-CONDITIONALS; natural integration point is a setstat widget so depends on F-VAR-MATH. 2026-06-29 research (specs/011-variables/research.md): SugarCube <<dialog>>+Dialog API are core but <<notify>> toast is a THIRD-PARTY macro (Chapel) — must not emit without the dependency; Harlowe (dialog:) 3.1+; Chapbook/Snowman have no native popup (DIY). Key idiom: mutate+notify in ONE idempotent unit so changes don't double-apply on re-render

title: Init-passage placement + variable manifest
summary: declare_variable should seed a variable's default into the format's INIT passage (SugarCube StoryInit; Harlowe startup-tagged; Chapbook once-only vars section; Snowman UserScript) instead of the Start passage; plus track a variable manifest (name; type; default; where shown; where mutated).
acceptance: New stats initialise in the format-correct init passage not Start; manifest answers what-stats-exist and flags used-before-init / mutated-but-never-shown / sigil-dialect errors
notes: Surfaced 2026-06-29 research (specs/011-variables/research.md) — shipped declare_variable writes the setter into Start; idiomatic stories init once in StoryInit/startup/vars-section/UserScript. Real placement gap in F-VARIABLES; refine before stat-heavy stories. Manifest extends the existing ActiveStory.variables registry

title: Teach logic via docstrings + guide resource
summary: Enrich tool docstrings AND twinery://guide with a format-aware logic capability matrix (set/computed-set/if/gated-link/setter-link/reusable/popup/init per format) so any calling model learns what logic is possible and how to emit it for the active format; consider format-aware elicitation.
acceptance: A model with no prior Twine knowledge can author correct logic for the active format from the MCP's docstrings/guide alone; mixed-dialect output (the headline failure mode) is prevented
notes: Surfaced 2026-06-29 — user's core ask: logic lives in passage text so the MCP must TEACH it; any model/agent should learn the dialect from docstrings/elicitation. Backed by 5-format research in specs/011-variables/research.md. Cross-cutting; should land alongside F-VAR-MATH/F-CONDITIONALS

title: Central stat-display tool
summary: A tool that renders the current stats in ONE shared place per format — SugarCube StoryCaption sidebar; Harlowe/Chapbook/Snowman header/footer passage — and defaults new stats into that block so they are visible without copying into every passage.
acceptance: One call produces a persistent stat readout that updates every passage; new declared stats appear there automatically
notes: Surfaced 2026-06-29 research — community-universal pattern (StoryCaption / header-footer). Needed for the life-sim persistent HUD and pairs with F-WIDGETS popups. Small but high-UX-value
